responsibility: Defines the DFA scheduling model for IBM POWER4 and the closely related PowerPC 970 class in the rs6000 backend. The file describes dispatch, integer, load/store, floating-point, branch, condition-register, and vector/permute resources, then assigns reservation, latency, and bypass rules to the backend’s instruction type attributes so GCC’s RTL scheduler can tune code motion and hazard avoidance for cpu=power4.
